question: How is maya described in the Shaiva scripture and what group of great gods is mentioned there?
premises: Maya is pervaded by the cavities of bhaga.
This is taught in the Shaiva scripture.
The scripture also mentions a group of eight great gods extending to the measure of a thumb in the night.
inference: The Shaiva teaching presents maya as internally divided by bhaga-cavities and associates it with an eightfold group of great gods.
uncertainties: The phrase aṅguṣṭhamātraparyantaṃ niśi is obscure in this excerpt and may refer to a specific doctrinal division.
plain_english: That maya is pervaded by the cavities of bhaga, as taught in the Shaiva scripture. Again, it speaks of a group of eight great gods, extending to the measure of a thumb, in the night.
